# Catalog provider fixtures

Captured on 2026-08-15 from the official ListenBrainz sitewide release-group statistics API and MusicBrainz release-group API.

- `listenbrainz-ok-computer-all-time.json` is trimmed to the OK Computer ranking row and its response metadata.
- `musicbrainz-ok-computer-release-group.json` contains only the official MusicBrainz `data` response, without Rescened's local cache wrapper or fetch timestamp.

ListenBrainz listening data and MusicBrainz core metadata are CC0. The fixtures retain Cover Art Archive identity metadata only; they do not contain or redistribute cover artwork.
